name: A Shield Nobody Asked For
hook: Mara asks Dain to help identify the workers erased from the quarry ledger
objectives: Recover three named records from the surface memorial and safe salvage route; speak to the families; let Mara choose the inscription
decision: Dain tries to add his confession to the memorial. Mara gives him a separate place to record it: the workers’ names are not a stage for his redemption
result: Dain and Ilyr agree on an explicit right to end their shared-body accord

name: A Lantern Left Burning
hook: A former apprentice asks Tessa to teach a technique that will not exhaust its user
objectives: Collect observations at three inhabited lantern stations; test a low-power circuit with the apprentice; return to the flooded gallery
decision: Tessa must leave the apprentice alone to solve the last fault rather than taking over
result: She establishes a small public workshop and shares the credit

name: The Returners’ Wall
hook: Edda wants a record of rescues, not only deaths
objectives: Find a damaged flight recorder; interview a survivor; repair a landing marker with the local crew
decision: Corren reads the unedited account of the cable he cut and does not demand that it be balanced by his later deeds
result: The hall adds a returners’ wall and an incident archive

name: The Unborrowed Engine
hook: Pell says the new engine works only while Ivo is standing beside it
objectives: Have three workers follow the manual; identify failures in the instructions; revise and demonstrate a cold restart
decision: The final restart occurs with Ivo observing rather than operating
result: The design and maintenance notes become freely available in every town

name: Every Road a Promise
hook: Two displaced communities ask for contradictory route priorities
objectives: Survey three visible crossings; uncover the route Nera once concealed; construct a shared schedule through dialogue and a small switch puzzle
decision: Nera admits her earlier bargain without asking the betrayed group to comfort her
result: Public maps include warnings, alternate routes and the people responsible for maintaining them

name: The Right to Refuse
hook: A patient rejects a vision-based treatment order bearing Oriel’s signature
objectives: Read the original authorization; hear the patient’s account; dismantle the automatic prognostic seal
decision: Oriel gives the patient the final decision even when she fears the outcome
result: The sanctuary changes its practice; her admission stays in the public record

name: What the Hand Remembers
hook: A survivor requests the location of another binding site, not Sable’s apology
objectives: Inspect three seals with their occupants; record the original design; remove the repeat-command mechanism
decision: Sable appears at the hearing without her sword and answers a specific question without qualification
result: She returns for the finale under the agreed conditions; afterward the hearing continues

name: The Names We Keep
hook: Jori brings people whose recovered legal names are not the ones they now choose
objectives: Match ledgers with testimony; offer a chosen-name correction; recover an official seal from a safe puzzle chamber
decision: Pip accepts that a technically accurate forgery can still make decisions for others
result: The registry allows amendments and records the author of every change

name: The Winter Without Sleep
hook: An island lantern burns each night while nobody in its village wakes
objectives: Enter the Cradle; warm the shelters; defeat B13 after learning its lantern tell; speak to the Winter Hind
decision: The creature has been keeping the village in a dream to protect it from a winter that has already ended
result: The sleepers wake; V07 becomes available

name: The Sea That Keeps Its Dead
hook: A harbor bell repeats a missing ship’s departure pattern
objectives: Follow redundant sound-and-light beacons; restore the passenger register; defeat B14; accept V08’s offer
decision: The Leviathan has been forced to repeat the wreck’s last instant. The party ends the repetition without erasing the record
result: The reef current opens and V08 becomes available

name: No More Crowns
hook: A recovered ministry automaton continues issuing Voss’s orders under the capital
objectives: Open the post-state echo chamber; read the command ledger; defeat B15 without obeying its false reward prompts
decision: An officer offers to keep the machine for benevolent use. The party disables its authority function and preserves the evidence
result: Award A023 and add a capital restoration scene

name: A Song Nobody Owns
hook: The listening pool contains a voice excluded from both human and dragon testimony
objectives: Obtain the listening phrase in Nacre; reach the reversible final antechamber; defeat B16 using its visible beat windows
decision: The Null Cantor asks only to be heard without being turned into a weapon
result: Award A024 and a final theme variation; no ninth party member
